name: software-team-agents
description: T90-T91 — the distributable unit for this framework's `sta` / `software-team-agents` CLI: orchestrator/dist (compiled orchestrator/src) plus templates/ (the framework's own .claude/agents, contracts, workflows, policies, stacks, etc., snapshotted by `npm run build`). This is deliberately a *different* package from orchestrator/package.json, which stays the private dev/test package for building and testing this repo's own orchestrator — this one is what `sta init`/`upgrade` (T92/T95) in a target project actually installs from, and its version field is the single source of truth for the Framework version stamped into templates/manifest.json and reported by `software-team-agents --version`. `private: true` on purpose: this file makes the package publishable-shaped, it does not itself decide to publish it to a registry.

scripts.release: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && node scripts/pack-release.mjs
scripts.test:benchmark: node planning/v4/benchmark/verify-oracles.mjs && node planning/v4/benchmark/build-metrics.mjs && node planning/v4/benchmark/build-run-ledger.mjs && node planning/v4/benchmark/verify-run-log.mjs && node planning/v4/benchmark/verify-value-report.mjs
